verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs describe stream selection (choosing which streams/properties to extract) and per-state-ID incremental replication tracking, which together let a user target and resync a single table without rerunning the whole pipeline (meltano-docs-19, meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated backfill/resync command (e.g., state reset for one stream) or hands-on community confirmation that this works smoothly in practice. missing for 10: explicit backfill/resync CLI workflow docs (e.g. `meltano state clear`), independent/community validation of single-table resync behavior.
